text:
alex_k: Hey team — quick question: who is allowed to run a prod canary outside business hours tonight? We need to push v2.4.1. :eyes:

maria_p: Who's on the deploy rota? I thought oncall can approve but we recently tightened MFA for the deployer role.

alex_k: Right. Our CI now requires 2FA on the deployer SSO session. I don't have the deployer role. Trying `deploy --env prod --canary 10% --release v2.4.1` but it errors with permission denied.

deploy-bot: Automated check: Release pipeline locked. Missing role: `releaser.prod` or active delegated session. See https://internal/runbooks/deploy-access

samir: If oncall can escalate via the breakglass flow we can grant temporary deployer for 1h. It's ENG-4721 flow (access request). But that requires an MFA-approved session from the approver.

jen_oncall: I can approve, but I need the request in the portal + a Slack ack. I can only start the JIT window if the requester has MFA enabled in SSO. Please confirm your SSO status.

alex_k: Confirmed, SSO MFA is enrolled. I submitted the portal request just now: ENG-4721.

maria_p: Nice. Samir — can you pre-stage the canary so we only need the final toggle? Helps reduce time-limited ops.

samir: Yep. Pre-staged artifacts uploaded to canary group. Command I used: `ci pipeline trigger --job canary-stage --tag v2.4.1`

jen_oncall: I'll open the JIT window once I see the portal flag and a Slack ack from you that you're ready. Also confirm you'll run the health checks listed in the runbook.

alex_k: Ready. Health checks: 200s on /health, memory within baseline, no error spike in the first 10m. I pasted the checklist in the portal comment.

deploy-bot: Note: deploys initiated outside of 09:00-18:00 require two approvers by policy. Current approver count: 1 (jen_oncall).

maria_p: I can act as second approver if needed. :thumbsup:

jen_oncall: Thanks — ok opening JIT. Granting `releaser.prod` for 45m to alex_k and enabling MFA session. ENG-4721 updated with approval.

alex_k: Got it, I see the role now. Running final command in ~5m:```bash
deploy --env prod --canary 10% --release v2.4.1 --verify=runbook-checks
```

samir: I'll watch metrics and be ready to rollback. If errors >5% in 10m we revert.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2026-03-20T22:07:03Z by alex_k (JIT session). Canary 10% -> health checks in progress.

jen_oncall: Thanks. Reminder: please capture a short post-release note in the release-notes channel (service, change, rollback criteria).

alex_k: Will do. Post-release note filed.

deploy-bot: Canary healthy after 12m. No errors > threshold. Promoting to 50% per rollout policy.

samir: All good on metrics. Proceeding.

alex_k: Full rollout initiated. Rolling to 100%.

deploy-bot: Release v2.4.1 promoted to 100% at 2026-03-20T22:30:15Z. Session `releaser.prod` revoked for alex_k (JIT expiry).

jen_oncall: Thanks everyone. Closing ENG-4721 and noting MFA/JIT flow worked.

maria_p: Great — minor ops win.

alex_k: TY!
